hints.title: Small Array Boundary
hints.text: If the array has 4 or fewer elements, we can change 3 elements to equal the remaining one, making difference 0.

hints.title: Extreme Element Modification
hints.text: Changing an element to any value inside the range never hurts. Optimal moves always eliminate either the smallest or largest elements.

hints.title: Four Possible Scenarios
hints.text: With 3 moves: remove 0 small and 3 large, 1 small and 2 large, 2 small and 1 large, or 3 small and 0 large. Take the minimum difference.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing combinations of non-extreme elements is suboptimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting in O(N log N) enables testing the 4 extreme cut combinations in O(1).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate enumerates the 4 prefix/suffix truncation combinations cleanly.
complexity.notes: Can also be solved in O(N) using partial sorting to find 4 smallest and 4 largest elements.
